name: visa-requirements
title: Visa Requirements Dataset
description: Short-stay tourist entry requirements for every ordinary-passport pair of countries and territories, normalised into six values with the permitted length of stay where one is published.

fields.name: passport
fields.title: Passport country
fields.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the country or territory that issued the ordinary passport.

fields.name: destination
fields.title: Destination country
fields.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the country or territory being entered.

fields.name: requirement
fields.title: Requirement
fields.description: What the traveller must obtain before or on arrival. See README for the full definition of each value.

fields.name: max_stay_days
fields.title: Maximum stay in days
fields.description: Days permitted on a single entry, where the destination publishes a number. Empty means the entitlement exists but no fixed length is published, or the length is set by the officer at the border. Empty is not zero.

fields.name: verified
fields.title: Last verified
fields.description: The date a human last re-read the primary source for this pair and found it still true. Empty means the pair comes from the base snapshot and has not been individually re-checked since.

fields.name: source
fields.title: Primary source
fields.description: The government or intergovernmental page the requirement was read from. Empty for pairs carried from the base snapshot.

fields.name: issues_passport
fields.title: Appears as a passport
fields.description: True if the entity issues an ordinary passport that appears in the passport column.

fields.name: is_destination
fields.title: Appears as a destination
fields.description: True if the entity appears in the destination column.

fields.name: verified
fields.title: Date the source was last re-read

fields.name: status
fields.title: Whether the change is in force
fields.description: applied means the change is reflected in visa-requirements.csv. pending means it is announced but not yet in force and is deliberately NOT reflected there.

fields.name: passport
fields.title: Passport country, empty if the change applies to all passports
